instruction: Cinematic action still, medium shot from a low angle in a boxing ring. On the left, the trainer in the black and orange sports top (R1) stands in profile, holding up a red focus mitt. On the right, the boxer in the white sports bra (R2) faces left, holding her black boxing glove against the mitt. The background is a dim gym with red ring ropes. Cool, low-key lighting with red accents.
elements: R1 is the trainer holding up a red focus mitt for R2
R2 is the boxer placing a black boxing glove against R1's mitt
R1 receives the glove contact with the mitt rather than striking R2
R2 is the gloved striker/contact-maker rather than the mitt holder
boxing ring with dim gym background and red ropes

questions.q: Is R1 holding up the focus mitt for R2's glove contact, rather than R2 holding the mitt for R1?
questions.element: R1 holds the mitt for R2

questions.q: Is R2 the boxer pressing or holding a black boxing glove against R1's mitt, rather than R1 pressing a glove against R2's mitt?
Does R1 take the trainer's receiving role with the focus mitt while R2 takes the boxer's striking-contact role, rather than the other way around?
questions.element: trainer-mitt role belongs to R1 and boxer-glove role belongs to R2

questions.q: Is R2 facing toward R1 while making glove-to-mitt contact with the mitt R1 holds?
questions.element: R2 faces R1 and contacts R1's mitt

questions.q: Is a red focus mitt present as the contact target in the boxing interaction?
Is a black boxing glove present and used against the focus mitt?
